_comment: Build-time input, and still present at /opt/srb/manifest-target.json in the agent image: the warm-up step at the end of this environment's Dockerfile copies it to /opt/warm/package.json and the offline mirror is built from it, so it cannot be deleted in the layer that uses it. It is not a hint. This is the union of every package the target closure is allowed to install, used to warm the npm cache and to prove the mirror can satisfy State B -- and instruction.md prints that same closure in full, because a solver who cannot see which packages the mirror carries cannot choose between them. The submission writes its own package.json; nothing reads this one at grading time.
name: srb-fw02-target-closure
